messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "wait at least 14 days after stopping before starting MAOI"
set: ["wait at least 14 days after stopping before starting MAOI", "wait at least 2 weeks after stopping an MAOI before starting fluoxetine", "wait at least 5 weeks after stopping fluoxetine before starting an MAOI or thioridazine", "starting dose for first 14 days", "at least five days", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "do not take within 5 days before or 14 days after using an MAO inhibitor", "given for at least five days before the dose is increased", "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "exercising at least 30 minutes most days", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "ask doctor before stopping", "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin", "do not use within 14 days before MAO inhibitor use", "false-positive result can continue for several days after stopping"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
